name: device
title: Device
description: MacBook, iMac, iPhone, and iPad bezels whose screen is a real DOM box, so it can hold video, an iframe, or any live content rather than only a flat image.
docs: Render <Device variant="macbook"><video src="/demo.mp4" autoPlay muted loop playsInline className="h-full w-full object-cover" /></Device>, or pass src="/shot.png" for a static screenshot. Variants: macbook (501x323 screen), imac (542x305, exactly 16:9), iphone (175x380), ipad (457x343). The artwork is split into a back SVG (body, bezel, screen fill) and a front SVG (the bits that overlap the glass, e.g. the MacBook notch and iPhone dynamic island), with children in an HTML box between them — so screen content sits under the notch the way it does on a real device. Screen geometry is declared in SVG user units and converted to percentages, so the device scales fluidly with its container; set a width on it via className. The screen fill uses currentColor, so text-black gives an off display behind transparent content. Adapted from the Device component in aliimam-in/templates.
